How LOOT works

Launch a coin on pump.fun and pair it to a brand. 80% of trading fees fund rewards for holders. 20% buys and burns $LOOT. Holders redeem what they earn as that brand's gift card.

Overview
#

Where trading fees go.

Trading a coin on pump.fun earns creator fees. Once enough has built up, they are claimed and split the same way every time.

Launch modes
#

How holders get paid, and who qualifies.

Create a coin, choose a brand, and launch on pump.fun. You pick how holders get paid, and how much they have to hold. Those choices are locked at launch.

Dividends

Rewards are paid on every claim. Your share is your share of the tokens that qualify. No draw. Hold more, earn more.

Giveaway

Rewards accumulate for 10 minutes. Eligible holders are given tickets. Hold more, get more tickets, and a higher chance to win. You can only win once.

Each giveaway prize is the cheapest US gift card for that brand, plus 10%. A $550 pot and a $10 card means 50 winners, each with enough to redeem one card. If the pot is too small for one prize, it rolls to the next draw.

Who qualifies
Hold at least the minimum and you qualify. Hold less and you don't, in both modes.
Draw times
Giveaways draw at :00, :10, :20, :30, :40, and :50 past every hour, UTC.
Nobody qualifies
Dividends record the claim without paying holders. Giveaways keep the fees and try again at the next draw.
Minimum holding
Minimum	Share of supply
100K tokens	0.01%
1M tokens	0.1%
10M tokens	1%

You pick one at launch. It never changes. Supply is 1B tokens. Giveaways use whole tokens as tickets. Dividends use your token balance. The bonding curve and the Pump pool never count.

Balances and redeeming
#

Turning earned fees into a gift card.

Earnings are credited to a balance for each wallet and brand.
Coins paired to the same brand add to the same balance.
To redeem, choose a gift card amount on the brand page. The balance is debited and the gift card is issued.
If your region isn't listed, transfer the balance to any other brand available in your region. If none are, cash it out as SOL.
There is a 20% penalty on SOL claims, so the gift card is the better deal.
If a gift card fails to issue or has an error, the spent amount is credited back.
Listing requirements
#

When a coin appears on LOOT.

It trades against SOL.
The paired brand is in the LOOT registry.
Its creator fees were locked to the 80/20 split at launch.
